definitions.full: H8282. sarah I. [ שָׂרָה ] noun feminine princess, noble lady ; — construct שָׂרָ֫תִי (Ges § 90l ) Lam 1:1 ; plural שָׂרוֺת 1Kin 11:3 , construct id. Est 1:18 ; suffix שָׂרוֺתֶיהָ Judg 5:29 , תֵיהֶם - Isa 49:23 ; — princess attending Sisera's mother Judg 5:29 ; so Solomon's wives 1Kin 11:3 , other queens Isa 49:23 (|| מְלָכִים ); wives of nobles Est 1:18 ; figurative of Jerusalem Lam 1:1 .
